body: - `blitz-net` reads a `file:` URL from disk only for a `file:` document or a top-level load — a stylesheet, `@import`, font, image or iframe load of one for any other document, remote pages included, is refused before any disk read with `FileForbidden` (fixed text, no URL or path, through the existing error path, no log site of its own); where it reads, it reads with no path restriction, and it has no response-size cap or request timeout — do not route agent- or user-supplied URLs through it without a decision recorded in the security plan. A failed load reaches `NetHandler::error`, on the public trait a default that does nothing, so a wrapping implementer that does not forward it compiles and drops the failure silently — forward it. blitz-dom builds a sub-resource request only through the one constructor that stamps its loading document as the initiator (clippy `disallowed-methods` on `Request::get`, the constructor alone under a single `expect`) — keep it so.

- **`file:` reads** → blitz-net reads a `file:` URL only for a `file:` document or a top-level load — any other stylesheet, `@import`, font, image or iframe load refused before a disk read with `FileForbidden` (fixed text, no URL or path) — and where it reads, any path with no restriction — through `Url::to_file_path` off wasm, a non-path URL a typed `InvalidInput` error; the WPT net provider joins request paths onto the WPT base.

title: 2026-11-14 — A clippy lint's `#[expect]` is checked by the clippy leg alone

data.head: ## 2026-11-14 — A clippy lint's `#[expect]` is checked by the clippy leg alone

body: `#[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods, reason = "…")]` reads nothing under a plain `cargo build` or `cargo test`: rustc does not check the expectation of a clippy lint without clippy, so a stale `expect` (one whose lint no longer fires) and a missing one both pass every non-clippy gate. Only the workspace clippy leg (`ci-leg.sh clippy`, inside `fast` and CI) fulfils or breaks it. A crate-level `clippy.toml` (escher's first, `packages/blitz-dom/clippy.toml`, banning `Request::get` outside `stamped_request`) is read by `cargo clippy -p {crate}` from the crate's own directory, and upstream's blitz-dom has none — an upstream sync that adds a `Request::get` call in blitz-dom reads green until the clippy leg runs. Prove such a guard by a control with the `expect` removed (measured at 2026-11-13-local-files-for-local-documents: `error: use of a disallowed method blitz_traits::net::Request::get`, exit 101).

The network layer now refuses to read a file: URL for a request whose loading document is not itself a file: document; a request with no loading document (an embedder's top-level load) or a file: one reads the file as before.
Every engine sub-resource request now carries the URL of the document that asked for it: linked stylesheet, its reload, @import, @font-face, CSS image, img and iframe — seven paths, 0 before.
The refusal is a new fixed-text network error with no URL or path in it, reaching the document's existing error path with no new log site.
The engine crate now builds a request only through one stamping constructor, enforced by a crate clippy config that disallows the plain request constructor.
A new blitz-tests integration target proves a remote page reads no local stylesheet, import, image or iframe while the same page as a file: document reads all four, in both layout modes; nothing was retired.

Two paths stay open and are not remedied here: the browser's favicon probe still reads a remote page's file: icon, and navigation from a remote page to a file: URL still loads it as a top-level document.

The session closed blitz-net's file: branch for a non-file: document: a file: URL is read from disk only for a request with no loading document (an embedder's top-level load) or with a file: loading document.
Every engine sub-resource request now carries its loading document's URL as an initiator: linked stylesheet, its reload, @import, @font-face, CSS image, img and iframe (0 to 7 paths).
A refused load fails with a new error variant whose text is fixed and names no URL or path, and reaches the document's handler through the existing error path, adding no log site, print, env read or panic path.
The file: load predicate moved to one body in blitz-traits and is re-exported from the script crate under its old name; blitz-dom may build a sub-resource request only through one stamping constructor, enforced by a crate clippy config.
A new silent blitz-tests check target proves a remote page reads no local stylesheet, @import, image or iframe while the same page as a file: document reads all four; the census of log sites and the witness silence probe both read 0.
Two paths stay open and are owed to a provisional route entry: the browser's favicon probe still reads a remote page's file: icon, and navigation from a remote page to a file: URL still loads it.

body:
The session closed blitz-net's file: branch to documents that are not themselves file: documents: a remote page's sub-resource fetch now reads no local file.
The shared request type gains an initiator, the URL of the document a sub-resource is loaded for; none means a top-level load no document asked for (an embedder's load or a navigation).
The engine stamps every one of its seven sub-resource paths with its document (linked stylesheet, its reload, CSS import, font-face, CSS image, img, iframe), through one constructor guarded by a crate clippy disallowed-methods rule with one expect.
blitz-net refuses a file: read for a non-file initiator with a new ProviderError FileForbidden, fixed text holding no URL or path, before any disk read; the refusal takes the existing error path and adds no log site.
The file-URL predicate document_may_load now has its one body in the shared traits crate, re-exported unchanged by the script fetcher; a new blitz-tests witness and blitz-net and traits unit tests prove it, CI green.
Two paths stay open and are owed to a provisional route entry: the browser's favicon probe still reads a remote page's file: icon, and navigation from a remote page to a file: URL still loads it top-level.

body_fields.what: the shared outbound request type (Request, non-exhaustive) with its new initiator field and builder, and the file-URL load predicate that decides which documents may load file: URLs
navigation options turned into a top-level request, which carries no initiator
the script fetcher (default script fetcher and JS-facing fetch), which now re-exports the file-URL load predicate instead of holding it
the blitz-net provider, outbound HTTP and file: reads, its typed ProviderError set gaining FileForbidden, and the file: read refusal for a non-file loading document
the engine's sub-resource loaders (stylesheet handler and loader, CSS import, font-face fetch) and the one request constructor that stamps the loading document
the document's request builder and its linked stylesheet, image, font-face and resource reload loads
the iframe load start, which stamps the parent document as initiator
the DOM mutator building the stylesheet handler for a linked sheet
the CSSOM script API's font-face rule insertion and stylesheet loader
the CSS background image layer fetch from style
blitz-dom's lint config, the construction guard that forbids building a request outside the stamping constructor; a new upstream merge surface
the witness check that a remote page reads no local file and a file page reads them all through blitz-net's real provider, and that every engine request carries its document
the blitz-tests manifest, its dev-dependencies gaining blitz-net and tokio, workspace-inherited
the lockfile, moved only in blitz-tests' own dependency list, no new package

decision/default-script-fetcher-local-only, decision/script-fetcher-file-data-only and decision/default-fetcher-file-and-data-only rest on the file-URL predicate, which moved its one body to the shared traits crate and is re-exported by the script fetcher, text and behaviour unchanged.

decision/outbound-http-through-blitz-net and decision/outbound-http-via-reqwest-or-blitz-net: blitz-net's provider now refuses a file: read for a request whose loading document is not a file: document, before any disk read.

decision/subresource-requests-get-only and decision/document-abort-signal-cancels-fetches: every engine sub-resource request is now built through one constructor that takes the signal and stamps the loading document; still a GET.
decision/net-handler-error-default-noop: a FileForbidden refusal reaches the handler's error method through the existing error path, so a handler that keeps the default does nothing on it.
decision/failed-stylesheet-blocks-no-render, decision/failed-load-ends-wait and decision/bounded-load-wait: a refused file: stylesheet, image or frame is a failed load on the existing error path.

decision/remote-content-nesting-limits, decision/iframe-nesting-depth-limit, decision/import-nesting-depth-limit and decision/stale-iframe-responses-discarded: iframe and CSS import loads now carry their parent document and a remote parent's file: frame or import is refused.
decision/hintless-font-face-source-sniffed and decision/no-agent-urls-through-font-path: the font-face fetch path now takes the document URL and a remote document's file: font source is refused.

contract/network-tracing-log/error, contract/network-tracing-log/url and contract/resource-load-failure-log/error: the refusal's only log line is the existing tracing-feature error line; the new error text is fixed and holds no URL or path.

absence/request-timeout, absence/response-size-limit and absence/response-body-size-limit still hold: blitz-net's file: read keeps no path restriction, size cap or timeout, now narrowed to file: documents and top-level loads.

absence/same-origin-cors-checks, absence/same-origin-and-cors-checks, absence/cors-checks, absence/same-origin-checks and absence/cors-same-origin-policy still hold: the new refusal is a scheme rule on file: alone, not an origin or CORS check.

decision/error-pages-skip-history-and-favicon and the favicon probe: the browser's favicon probe still fetches a page's icon with no loading document, so a remote page's file: icon is still read from disk; owed to a provisional route entry.

decision/external-navigation-schemes, decision/external-navigation-get-http-mailto and decision/iframe-navigation-to-parent: a navigation is a top-level load with no initiator, so navigation from a remote page to a file: URL still loads it.
decision/png-encodes-screenshots and decision/png-shot-encoder: a blitz-tests check now also encodes a PNG fixture through the png dev-dependency, test-only.

decision/workspace-inherited-dependency-versions, decision/locked-builds and decision/blitz-tests-not-published: blitz-tests gains blitz-net and tokio as workspace-inherited dev-dependencies; the lockfile moves only in blitz-tests' list, no new package, audit and licences pass.
decision/upstream-sync-dependency-set and decision/engine-dependency-pins: blitz-dom gains a crate clippy config upstream lacks, a new upstream merge surface.
contract/environment-variables/rust-log and decision/driver-reads-only-rust-log: the new witness reads CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR at build time, test-only; no production runtime env read added.
decision/dioxus-scheme-local-files: the dioxus scheme's local files load as top-level or file: document loads; check the file: rule's new reach does not contradict it.

blitz-dom builds a sub-resource request only through the one constructor that stamps its loading document, enforced by a crate clippy disallowed-methods rule on Request::get with a single expect exception at that constructor.

blitz-net's FileForbidden refusal has a fixed display text, file: load refused for a non-file document, holding no URL or path, and reaches the handler only through the existing error path with no log site of its own.

Data protection rows: history store, cookies, HTTP cache, TLS, clipboard, file dialog and kept-check files are not reached.
The driver session socket, MCP server and escher-session CLI rows, their contracts, exit codes, refusal causes and bounds: no verb, wire or role changed.
Snapshot, stable element id, accessibility, select list, range, password mask and actions or graph answer rows: no reading, mask or carrier moved.
Cold-agent, recording, coverage floor, apt-install and agent-run tooling rows: no script or gate of theirs changed.
Logging sink allowlist, target scrub and stderr telemetry sink rows: no log field, target or scrub shape moved.
CI secrets, signing, actions pinning and WPT runner rows: no CI step, workflow or script changed.

body_fields.why: The basis only retells how the request initiator is stamped on each engine sub-resource path and states no reason for it, which the code holds.
The basis is a count of test files and of CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR readers, an inventory the code and the sidecar hold, not a name the register reserves.

body:
blitz-net's file: branch now serves a file: URL only to a request with no loading document or with a file: loading document; any other is refused with the fixed-text error FileForbidden, before any disk read.
Every engine sub-resource request (linked stylesheet, its reload, @import, @font-face, CSS image, img, iframe) now carries its document's URL as the request's initiator; a navigation and an embedder's top-level load carry none.
The file: predicate moved to one body in blitz-traits, re-exported where vibey-script held it; blitz-dom builds a request only through one stamping constructor, enforced by a crate-level clippy disallowed-methods config and one expect.
A new blitz-tests target local_files_for_local_documents checks, in both layout modes, that every engine request carries its document and that a remote page reads no local file through blitz-net's real provider while a file: page reads all four; unit tests in blitz-traits and blitz-net cover the predicate table (6 rows, count asserted) and the refusal offline.
blitz-tests gains blitz-net and tokio as dev-dependencies, and a check now encodes a PNG through the png dev-dependency; blitz-tests top-level files measure 171 to 172, targets 170 to 171; three controls held red-before-green; CI green 17 of 17.

body_fields.what: blitz-dom's crate-level clippy config, read by the workspace clippy leg and the blitz-dom all-targets clippy run; it disallows building a request outside the stamping constructor

the new blitz-tests integration target, one behaviour: file: URLs loadable only from a file: document across engine sub-resource loads, with two hand-written network stand-ins and fixture files written under CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR
the shared network request type and the file: URL predicate (document_may_load), with its inline unit test module
navigation options turned into a top-level request, which carries no loading document
vibey-script's script fetch, which re-exports the file: URL predicate for script loads
blitz-net's network provider and its typed provider errors, the file: read branch, and its inline unit tests
blitz-dom's sub-resource loading: stylesheet, @import and @font-face handlers, and the one request constructor that stamps the loading document
the base document: its request builder, linked stylesheet and image loads, and stylesheet loader construction
iframe sub-document loading from its parent document
the DOM mutator, which constructs a stylesheet handler for a linked sheet
the CSSOM, which builds a stylesheet loader and inserts @font-face rules that fetch fonts
style damage handling, which fetches CSS background image layers
the blitz-tests manifest and its dev-dependencies, the manifest's difference from upstream
the workspace lockfile the locked cargo legs read

body: The decision that file: URLs are loadable only from a file: document: its rule states script loads alone, and now reaches every engine sub-resource load through blitz-net; its guard cell gains local_files_for_local_documents and blitz-net's offline unit test.
The decision on PNG decoding in checks through the png dev-dependency: a blitz-tests check now also encodes a PNG through it (a fixture image).
The decision on the blitz-tests manifest's difference from upstream: it gains two dev-dependencies, blitz-net and tokio with the rt feature.

The rules of one test target per file and one integration target per behaviour, and the rule that the blitz-tests manifest holds one test target: a new auto-discovered target joins; a row holding a blitz-tests file or target count moves 171 to 172 files, 170 to 171 targets.
The clippy legs over the workspace and blitz-dom: blitz-dom now carries a crate-level clippy config whose disallowed-methods entry fails the leg on any request built outside the one expect.

Hand-written stand-ins, no mocking library: two new hand-written network stand-ins, one recording requests and leaving them in flight, one reading through blitz-net's real provider on a current-thread runtime it owns.
Network stand-ins keep their loads counted, and the harness counts loads of fetching providers only: the new stand-ins answer inside fetch on the test's thread or leave requests in flight.
Layout assertions in both layout modes: both new integration checks loop over the two layout modes.
Table-driven tests assert their row count: the predicate table holds 6 rows with its count asserted.
Unit tests in inline test modules in their source file: new inline test modules in blitz-traits' network module and in blitz-net.
Tests controlled red-before-green: three controls held (refusal removed, stamp removed, expect removed), each removed firing showing its case run and failed.

Test data stated in code, nothing seeded: the new check writes its fixture files (a stylesheet, an import, an image, an iframe page) from code into a test-only directory under CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR read by build-time env!.
A failed load ends the settle wait, and the harness settle's failed-load item: a refused file: sub-resource now reaches the handler's error path as a failed load.

A file joining a leg keeps its legs, and the agent-run selections run all and run {file}: the new target is in workspace test, run all and run local_files_for_local_documents, and not in the stand-repeat list.
Cargo legs run locked and the dependency audit: the lockfile moves in blitz-tests' own dependency list only, no new package enters, audit passed.
Regression tests document and are named for their bug: the new target is named for the behaviour that closes a remote page reading local files.

body_fields.fact: Every engine sub-resource request (linked stylesheet, its reload, @import, @font-face, CSS image, img, iframe) carries its loading document's URL, checked in both layout modes; a navigation or embedder top-level load carries none.

blitz-dom builds a request only through its one stamping constructor, enforced by a crate-level clippy disallowed-methods config and one expect; the clippy leg fails on any other, and upstream's blitz-dom has no such config, a new merge surface.
The test-only directory local_files_for_local_documents under CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR is occupied by the blitz-tests target of that name.

A blitz-tests check may read file: loads through blitz-net's real provider inside a hand-written stand-in, blocking on a current-thread tokio runtime it owns; blitz-net and tokio are blitz-tests dev-dependencies for it.

body: The session, driver, MCP and escher-session command-line contracts, exit codes, wire and recording rows: no session or driver surface moved.
Agent-run and cold-agent events, verbs, exit codes and verdict rows: no harness script or status shape changed.
WPT runner, conformance and reftest rows: no WPT surface moved.
Coverage floor values, mutation testing and complexity ceiling rows: no floor, threshold or budget moved.
Stand checks, stand repeat rounds and the zero-failure budget: the new target joins no stand list.
Handler coverage, lint defects, contrast and snapshot rows, and the harness construction, input and screenshot contracts: the harness and shared test modules stand unchanged.
CI artifacts, apt-install, action pinning, secrets, permissions and cache rows: no CI step, script or workflow changed.
